name: Remove token formation
definition: Replace the fitted G1 component with the B0 GLYPH-level IID baseline inside an otherwise-unchanged G2/G3 model
measures: G1's own contribution to held-out predictive/structural performance
not_applicable_to: M0-M5 (they ARE token formation; ablating it leaves nothing to measure)
notes: Directly supports task85 section 38 CONTEXT_INFORMATION_GAIN's denominator

name: Remove local context
definition: Set G2's context window width to 0 (degenerate to the frozen G1 back-off) inside an otherwise-unchanged M6/M7

name: Remove line position
definition: Deactivate only the LINE-position/boundary conditioning variables inside M7, keeping any other active STRUCTURAL_STATE variables
measures: The specific contribution of line-position/boundary structure
notes: One of several possible partial-G3 ablations; distinct from A4

name: Remove hierarchy
definition: Deactivate all STRUCTURAL_STATE variables inside M7 (degenerates to M6)
measures: G3's total contribution over G2 (task85 section 39 STRUCTURAL_INFORMATION_GAIN)

name: Remove lexical memory
definition: Replace any explicit stored TOKEN/COMPONENT-identity memory (M0's frequency table; M6's TOKEN-identity n-gram; M7's stratum-memorized TOKENs) with the model's own pure GLYPH-formation fallback (an M1-M5 instance)
measures: Whether predictive/structural performance depends on memorized vocabulary rather than productive formation rules (task85 section 33 lexicon accounting, applied as an ablation)
not_applicable_to: M1-M5 (no separate lexical-memory component to remove; they are already formation-only)

name: Remove state
definition: Deactivate automaton-state memory (M3/M4's finite-state memory) or stratum-state (M7's STRUCTURAL_STATE indexing), replacing it with the corresponding memoryless/pooled fallback
measures: Whether performance depends on retained state rather than immediate local structure
notes: For M7 this ablation is equivalent to A4 when all STRUCTURAL_STATE variables constitute the "state"; kept as a separate id because M3/M4's automaton state is a distinct mechanism from M7's stratum state
